logistics_philosophy: We prioritize 'The Korea Transit Sweet Spot': finding the lowest cost transportation that does NOT sacrifice convenience, time, or hassle. Saving $4 on an airport train after a 12-hour flight or saving $14 on an intercity bus to sit in 2 hours of highway traffic is a poor trade-off.

cheapest_option.hassle_level: High (Subway bench seats, crowded with commuters, standing with heavy luggage)

sweet_spot_option.hassle_level: Zero (Reserved reclining seats, dedicated luggage racks, free Wi-Fi, drops at Seoul Station)
sweet_spot_option.why_sweet_spot: For only $9.35 extra total for both travelers, you eliminate commuter crowds and get a relaxing non-stop express ride after a transpacific flight.

cheapest_option.hassle_level: High (Cramped seats, traffic risk, long travel day)

sweet_spot_option.mode: KTX High-Speed Train (or KORAIL Saver Pass)
sweet_spot_option.hassle_level: Zero (305 km/h bullet train, center-to-center from Seoul Station to Busan Station)
sweet_spot_option.why_sweet_spot: Saves 2 full hours of travel time! If doing a multi-city loop (Seoul->Busan->Gyeongju->Seoul), the KORAIL Saver Pass drops your effective cost even lower.

luxury_option.mode: Premium Gold Reclining Express Bus (160° Pods)
luxury_option.hassle_level: Medium (Luxury lie-flat comfort, but still 4+ hours on highway)

sweet_spot_comparisons.scenario: Short Urban Hop (<3.5 km with Luggage or in Rain)

cheapest_option.hassle_level: Medium-High (Stair climbing, navigating turnstiles with bags)

sweet_spot_option.hassle_level: Zero (Driver picks you up at hotel curb and drops at destination)
sweet_spot_option.why_sweet_spot: Because taxi base fares are only 4,800 KRW and you are splitting between 2 travelers, you pay only ~$2 USD extra total to save 20 minutes of stairs and hassle!

sweet_spot_comparisons.scenario: Intensive Seoul Sightseeing Day (4+ Transit Rides)

cheapest_option.hassle_level: Low (Must monitor cash balance and top up at convenience stores)

sweet_spot_option.hassle_level: Zero (Unlimited rides on all Seoul subways and blue/green buses for 15,000 KRW / 5 days = 3,000 KRW/day)
sweet_spot_option.why_sweet_spot: At 3,000 KRW per person per day, you break even after just 2 rides! Never worry about top-ups during your Seoul days.

operating_hours_directory.system: AREX Airport Express Train (ICN <-> Seoul Station)
operating_hours_directory.operating_hours: From ICN T2: 05:15 - 22:40 | From Seoul Station: 06:10 - 22:50

operating_hours_directory.peak_rush_hours: Friday afternoon & Sunday evening trains sell out fastest
Runs every 25-40 minutes across nightlife hubs
Sunset slots sell out 2-3 weeks in advance
